manifest.description: Synthetic playtest pack: 3 professions, 8 materials, 8 recipes with crafted items, 3 give-to-player recipe items, 8 perks, 4 stash items, 3 test characters, 3 journals, 1 roll table, 1 hireling and perk, 1 GM-only link macro. 8 locations (a Region point-crawl plus Normal/Hot/Deadly sites) with gathering nodes for the Locations module. Includes one GM-only material, one draft recipe/item and hidden location content as deliberate visibility examples. Not canon.
